{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# Phase 1A Multi-seed Training Runner
# 8 runs: PCGrad s123/s456, UG s123/s456, LO s123/s456, TG s456, SS s456
# Each followed by AR eval (N=50, β=0/3/5) using eval_200.json

cd /root/turn_residual_gating
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base

MODEL=/root/.cache/modelscope/Qwen/Qwen2___5-7B-Instruct
DATA_DIR=data/ultrachat_8k
EVAL_DATA=data/eval_200/eval_200.json
AR_OUT=results/d048_phase1a_ar
LOG_FILE=logs/phase1a_multiseed.log

mkdir -p "$AR_OUT" logs

exec > >(tee -a "$LOG_FILE") 2>&1

COMPLETED=0
FAILED=0
TOTAL=8

run_train_and_eval() {
    local RUN_NUM=$1
    local LABEL=$2
    local CONDITION=$3
    local GATE_TYPE=$4
    local CKPT_DIR=$5
    shift 5
    local TRAIN_CMD=("$@")

    echo ""
    echo "============================================================"
    echo "[$RUN_NUM/$TOTAL] $LABEL"
    echo "Start: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
    echo "Output: $CKPT_DIR"
    echo "============================================================"

    # Skip if checkpoint already complete
    if [ -f "$CKPT_DIR/gate_params.pt" ] || [ -f "$CKPT_DIR/epoch_2/gate_params.pt" ] || \
       ([ "$GATE_TYPE" = "none" ] && [ -d "$CKPT_DIR/epoch_2/lora" ]); then
        echo "SKIP: checkpoint already exists at $CKPT_DIR"
    else
        # Training
        echo "Training command: ${TRAIN_CMD[*]}"
        set +e
        PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 "${TRAIN_CMD[@]}"
        local TRAIN_EXIT=$?
        set -e

        if [ $TRAIN_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "FAILED: $LABEL training exited with code $TRAIN_EXIT"
            ((FAILED++))
            return 1
        fi
        echo "Checkpoint: $CKPT_DIR"
    fi

    echo "Training done at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"

    # AR Eval
    echo "--- AR Eval: N=50, β=0,3,5 ---"
    local EVAL_NAME="${CONDITION}_ar_n50"
    set +e
    CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 python src/eval_attention_steering.py \
      --checkpoint "$CKPT_DIR" \
      --mode gen \
      --gate-type "$GATE_TYPE" \
      --data-file "$EVAL_DATA" \
      --max-convs 50 \
      --beta 0 3 5 \
      --output-dir "$AR_OUT" \
      --output-name "$EVAL_NAME"
    local EVAL_EXIT=$?
    set -e

    if [ $EVAL_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
        echo "WARNING: $LABEL eval exited with code $EVAL_EXIT (training OK)"
    else
        echo "Eval saved: $AR_OUT/$EVAL_NAME.json"
    fi

    ((COMPLETED++))
    echo "[$RUN_NUM/$TOTAL] $LABEL COMPLETE at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
    return 0
}

echo "========================================"
echo "Phase 1A Multi-seed Runner"
echo "Started: $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')"
echo "GPU: $(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name --format=csv,noheader)"
echo "========================================"

# Common params for gated variants (TG, UG, PCGrad, SS)
GATE_COMMON=(--gar-loss-mode mse_target --gar-target 0.5 \
  --lambda-gar 1.0 --lambda-gate-div 1.0 \
  --min-gate-std 0.05 --init-bias 1.5 \
  --gate-lr-multiplier 10)
TRAIN_COMMON=(--lr 2e-4 --batch-size 1 --grad-accum 8 --max-seq-len 2048 --epochs 3)

# ──────────────────────────────────────────
# [1/8] PCGrad s123
# ──────────────────────────────────────────
run_train_and_eval 1 "PCGrad s123" "pcgrad_s123" "threadgate" "runs/d048_pcgrad_s123" \
  python src/train_phase2_v9_pcgrad.py \
    --model $MODEL --gate-type threadgate \
    "${GATE_COMMON[@]}" "${TRAIN_COMMON[@]}" \
    --seed 123 --output-dir runs/d048_pcgrad_s123 --data-dir $DATA_DIR

# ──────────────────────────────────────────
# [2/8] PCGrad s456
# ──────────────────────────────────────────
run_train_and_eval 2 "PCGrad s456" "pcgrad_s456" "threadgate" "runs/d048_pcgrad_s456" \
  python src/train_phase2_v9_pcgrad.py \
    --model $MODEL --gate-type threadgate \
    "${GATE_COMMON[@]}" "${TRAIN_COMMON[@]}" \
    --seed 456 --output-dir runs/d048_pcgrad_s456 --data-dir $DATA_DIR

# ──────────────────────────────────────────
# [3/8] Uniform Gate s123
# ──────────────────────────────────────────
run_train_and_eval 3 "UG s123" "ug_s123" "uniform" "runs/d048_ug_s123" \
  python src/train_phase2.py \
    --model $MODEL --gate-type uniform \
    "${GATE_COMMON[@]}" "${TRAIN_COMMON[@]}" \
    --seed 123 --output-dir runs/d048_ug_s123 --data-dir $DATA_DIR

# ──────────────────────────────────────────
# [4/8] Uniform Gate s456
# ──────────────────────────────────────────
run_train_and_eval 4 "UG s456" "ug_s456" "uniform" "runs/d048_ug_s456" \
  python src/train_phase2.py \
    --model $MODEL --gate-type uniform \
    "${GATE_COMMON[@]}" "${TRAIN_COMMON[@]}" \
    --seed 456 --output-dir runs/d048_ug_s456 --data-dir $DATA_DIR

# ──────────────────────────────────────────
# [5/8] LoRA-only s123
# ──────────────────────────────────────────
run_train_and_eval 5 "LO s123" "lo_s123" "none" "runs/d048_lo_s123" \
  python src/train_phase2.py \
    --model $MODEL --gate-type none \
    --gar-loss-mode mse_target --gar-target 0.5 --lambda-gar 1.0 \
    "${TRAIN_COMMON[@]}" \
    --seed 123 --output-dir runs/d048_lo_s123 --data-dir $DATA_DIR

# ──────────────────────────────────────────
# [6/8] LoRA-only s456
# ──���───────────────────────────────────────
